daily_load_assessment: Today's readiness indicates a balanced state with CTL at ~38.9 and ATL at ~35.5, resulting in a slightly positive TSB. No recent sleep or HRV data implies you must rely on subjective feel, but your recent training block shows adequate tolerance to loading. Ensure you are well-fueled before executing any session.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the past 21 days, training consistency has been maintained with a mix of steady aerobic mileage and high-intensity cycling/running sessions. The current ramp rate aligns well with the target of approaching a CTL of 60 safely, keeping acute fatigue manageable without crossing into overtraining markers.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: The 180-day trend reveals steady accumulation of aerobic base, heavily supported by consistent cycling commutes and targeted quality intervals. FTP sits robustly at 258W (3.26 W/kg), and consistent progression in 5km running metrics confirms the efficacy of the 70/30 pyramidal distribution model.
coach_verdict: Your primary focus today should be Priority 1: an aerobic Zone 2 cycling session to reinforce your low-intensity engine and maintain the 70/30 pyramidal balance. If you are feeling fresher and looking to stimulate upper body hypertrophy and core strength, Priority 2 (Strength Training) is a viable alternative.

priority_1.workout_details: 60 minutes continuous cycling at 65-75% of FTP (approx. 165-193W). Keep cadence smooth at 90-95 RPM.
priority_1.reason: Maintains the 70/30 pyramidal distribution rule, builds aerobic efficiency, and promotes active recovery without spiking ATL.

priority_2.session_title: Full Body Strength & Upper Body Hypertrophy
priority_2.workout_details: Squat: 3x5 @ 70% 1RM; Bench Press: 3x8; Barbell Rows: 3x8; Weighted Dips: 3x10; Core Planks: 3x60s.
priority_2.reason: Supports cycling torque and running power while addressing upper body aesthetics (chest, shoulders, abs) without adding cardiovascular fatigue.

priority_3.workout_details: 10 min warm-up jog, 4 x 4 minutes at 5km race pace with 2 minutes easy jog recovery, 10 min cool-down.
priority_3.reason: High-intensity quality session targeting 5km running goals, but only recommended if fully recovered and mentally prepared.
